This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="TBOBF 1" />

==Biology and appearance==
This bipedal [[humanoid]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their pointed [[ear]]s, short spikes spread symmetrically across their faces, and [[Color|orange]] patches on their skin.<ref name="TBOBF 1" />

==Species in the galaxy==
By [[9 ABY]],<ref name="9 ABY Date">{{BoBFDate}}</ref> at least one other member of the species frequented [[Garsa Fwip's Sanctuary]] in [[Mos Espa]] on [[Tatooine]],<ref name="TBOBF 1">{{BOBF|Chapter 1: Stranger in a Strange Land}}</ref> seemingly perishing alongside [[Garsa Fwip|Fwip]] when the [[Pyke Syndicate]] destroyed it.<ref name="TBOBF 6">{{BOBF|Chapter 6: From the Desert Comes a Stranger}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The species made their debut in the [[Chapter 1: Stranger in a Strange Land|first episode]] of the [[2021]] television series ''[[Star Wars: The Book of Boba Fett]]'', directed by [[Robert Rodriguez]].<ref name="TBOBF 1" />
